source_text: Backup restore drill report: api database Sorrel platform team · Drill DR-2023-02 Drill DR-2023-02 Date 2023-06-13 (Tuesday) Scope Restore the api primary database from the nightly backup into the restore account in eu-west-1 Recovery point Nightly backup of 2023-06-13 01:00 JST Drill lead Ravi Observer Mei Results Step Target Actual Result 1. Find the latest nightly backup in object storage 10 min 6 min Pass 2. Copy the backup to the restore account in eu-west-1 45 min 38 min Pass 3. Restore the database from the backup 90 min 2 h 04 min Fail 4. Check row counts against the production snapshot 20 min 17 min Pass 5. Start api against the restored database and make a test booking 30 min 22 min Pass Total time to a working api 4 h 3 h 27 min Pass Step 3 was slow because the restore used the default instance size. The bookings table came back with 41,880,112 rows, matching the production snapshot exactly. Follow-up: restore to a larger instance size and repeat the drill in December. Ravi Drill lead: Ravi Date: 2023-06-15 Mei Reviewed: Mei Date: 2023-06-16
